notes: The fighting-position branch wins before the empty-argument response and preserves C punctuation.
Carve has no skill gate; a standing caller with no target receives C's exact prompt even when untrained.
An absent room object reaches the exact target-not-found branch.
A visible non-corpse object reaches the initials message.
A corpse lacking the carve_ keyword reaches the exact impossible-food branch.
A living room target is rejected before room-object lookup.
Self-targeting reaches the dedicated self-mutilation refusal.
A valid generated corpse without a wielded tool reaches C's no-tool branch.
The generated corpse is carved with a slash weapon, including actor, observer, and inventory bytes.
one_argument consumes only the first non-fill target token.
A wielded weapon whose value[3] is neither slash nor pierce reaches C's exact rejection and extracts the temporary food.
The count-only CAN_CARRY_N gate runs before weapon validation.
Exact isname mapping yields meat, fish, bird, rabbit, and meat fallback prototype vnums.
Corpse contents are moved to the room in C prepend order before corpse extraction.
Generated NPC corpse keywords preserve the source mob keyword list plus corpse, so downstream corpse predicates see the same C name.
